source: NCERT Class VII, Exploring Society: India and Beyond, Economics Ch. 2.

sections.heading: 1. What is a Market
points: A **market** is any arrangement where **buyers and sellers** come together to exchange **goods and services** for money.
A market need not be a physical place — an **online market** works over the internet.
Markets link **producers** (sellers) with **consumers** (buyers).

sections.heading: 2. Demand, Supply and Price
points: **Demand** = how much of a good buyers are willing to buy at a price.
**Supply** = how much sellers are willing to sell at a price.
**Price** is decided by the interaction of demand and supply.
Generally: if **demand rises** (or supply falls), **price rises**; if **supply rises** (or demand falls), **price falls**.

sections.heading: 3. Types of Markets and the Chain
points: **Wholesale market** — goods sold in **large quantities** to shopkeepers.
**Retail market** — goods sold in **small quantities** to consumers.
**Local/weekly markets, shops, malls, online platforms** all serve different needs.
Chain: **Producer → Wholesaler → Retailer → Consumer** (value and price rise along the way).

sections.heading: 4. Markets, Fairness and Regulation
points: Markets help **allocate resources** and give consumers **choice**, but they are **not always fair** — small producers may earn little, and there can be **cheating or hoarding**.
The **government regulates** markets — setting standards, checking weights and prices, protecting **consumer rights**.
Ideas like **fair trade** aim to give producers a **fair price**.

sections.heading: 5. High-Yield One-Liners (Last-Minute Recall)
points: Market = buyers + sellers exchanging goods/services (may be physical or online).
Price is set by demand & supply; demand↑/supply↓ → price↑.
Wholesale = bulk to shopkeepers; retail = small quantity to consumers.
Chain: Producer → Wholesaler → Retailer → Consumer.
Government regulates markets & protects consumer rights; fair trade = fair price to producers.

sections.heading: 6. Common Traps (Watch Out)
points: **Price** is determined by the interaction of **demand and supply**, not by sellers alone.
**Wholesale = bulk**; **retail = small quantities to consumers** — don't swap.
A market can exist **without a physical place** (online markets).
Markets need **regulation** because they are not automatically fair to everyone.
